principles: Start the consensus cohort before any threshold signer or APP auction process.
Require advancing, pinned consensus before enabling any application operation.
Keep the site loopback-only; HTTPS and external exposure remain a separate action.
Never reset or copy Comet signing state, validator keys, FROST shares, coordinator identity, or initialized databases.
Stop and reconcile on unexpected state; never delete state or blindly retry.

phases.name: validator-consensus
preconditions: FIPS active; validator and signer inactive with zero restarts and no pending jobs.
Genesis SHA-256 8574fadb77fafea9c56fff7cff32af0205be7b2e05d12f1ab1fcf4a1a8f3a4ea and launch seal SHA-256 a106c0a408f6f5ae35841fbe3efd416007f7578c1d62f35126b2aadc1655765c.
Validator guard passes and priv_validator_state metadata is fresh at height 0/round 0/step 0.
phases.mutation: Run systemctl start plebeian-friday-validator.service on V1-V4 under one exact approval.
acceptance: All four units remain active without a restart loop.
Loopback Comet /status reports chain plebeian-auctions-mvp-20261102 and an advancing height on all four hosts.
Loopback /net_info reports the expected authenticated peer mesh.
A commit at a common positive height contains all four expected validator signatures.
phases.securityEffect: Each validator begins using its existing local Comet voting key. priv_validator_state and chain data advance irreversibly and must never be rolled back. P2P remains on the FIPS ULA and RPC remains loopback-only.
phases.failurePolicy: Stop only the validator units started by this action if the approved failure cleanup is exercised; preserve all data and signing state and report before any retry.

phases.name: app-observer
preconditions: Phase 1 has a pinned advancing four-validator commit.
Observer guard passes and the observer contains no validator signing files.
phases.mutation: Run systemctl start plebeian-friday-observer.service on APP.
acceptance: Observer remains active without a restart loop.
Loopback /status is not catching up and observes two successive increasing heights matching the validator chain.
phases.securityEffect: The observer uses its existing non-voting Comet P2P key and writes only its observer data leaf. It cannot sign validator votes.

phases.name: threshold-signers
preconditions: Signer guards pass, validators remain active, and no signer RPC listener exists before start.
phases.mutation: Run systemctl start plebeian-friday-signer.service on V1-V4.
acceptance: All four signer units remain active; Restart=no preserves fail-stop behavior.
The APP authority's authenticated challenge-bound /v1/health collection later observes at least three, preferably all four, exact enrolled participants.
phases.securityEffect: Each signer begins using its existing local FROST share and durable journal. Shares remain on their hosts. Port 39101 is reachable only on the FIPS ULA and health is authenticated; it is not a public readiness endpoint.

phases.name: app-scoped-activation-config
phases.mutation: Atomically retain and replace only APP friday.env and sidequest-runtime-bindings.json with the deterministic activation render.
phases.securityEffect: New auction operations and the close trigger become eligible only after authority and site processes start and their composite checks pass. This does not expose a network listener by itself.

phases.name: app-auction-services-loopback
preconditions: Phases 1-4 accepted; mint and FIPS remain active; all 18 initialized databases still pass SQLite quick_check.
phases.mutation: Start coordinator, then authority, then site. Do not enable units persistently yet.
acceptance: Coordinator and authority remain active without restart loops and the authority binds only 127.0.0.1:8181.

Two authority /api/friday/status samples at least one second apart observe increasing heights, a matching live mint, at least three authenticated signers, mode normal, funding enabled_two_step_nip07, and newOperationsReady=true.

Site pre-start guards pass, site binds only 127.0.0.1:8180, /api/config reports both browser threshold readiness flags true, and /test-mint reaches the pinned fake-sat mint without redirect or content-encoding drift.
phases.securityEffect: Coordinator and authority begin writing the initialized SQLite stores and can authorize fake-sat threshold operations. The site remains unavailable to remote team browsers because it is loopback-only.

phases.name: separate-https-exposure-and-five-user-rehearsal
targets: APP and five Plebeian test users
preconditions: A separately approved and verified HTTPS certificate and reverse-proxy configuration are available.
phases.mutation: Under separate approval, install/activate HTTPS proxying to loopback site and run the five-user NIP-07 fake-sat auction rehearsal.
acceptance: Five distinct NIP-07 identities log in and each receives exactly 10000 fake sats.
A test auction admits bids, returns the losing bidder's locked value, and settles 180 fake sats to the seller with the expected winner balance.
One validator outage/rejoin, interrupted or repeated actions, and restart recovery behave as specified without real funds.
phases.currentBlocker: nginx is inactive and disabled; no port 80/443 listener or Let's Encrypt live entry exists. HTTPS/external exposure is not authorized by this plan.

shortestSafeNextAction.exactApprovalRequest: May I start the V1-V4 validator services and verify that the pinned chain advances with a four-validator commit? This will use their existing Comet voting keys and permanently advance their signing-state files. It will not start FROST signers or APP auction services, change configuration, firewalls or HTTPS, expose the site, or make payments. If acceptance fails, I will stop only the validator units started by this action, preserve all data and signing state, and report before any retry.

notAuthorizedByThisPlan: Any service start, stop, enable, disable or restart
Any firewall, nginx, certificate or external exposure change
Any payment or five-user acceptance action
Any private key or FROST share export, hash, copy or reset
